description:
The usa.gdt dataset is open in Gretl. It contains real US quarterly macroeconomic data from the Federal Reserve FRED database (1984Q1 to 2009Q3) with two variables: 'gdp' (real GDP in billions of chained 2005 dollars) and 'inf' (CPI inflation rate, annualized %).

Estimate an AR(1) model (autoregressive model of order 1) for the 'inf' (inflation) variable. Use the menu: Model > Time series > ARIMA. In the ARIMA dialog, set: p (AR order) = 1, d (differencing) = 0, q (MA order) = 0. Select 'inf' as the dependent variable and click OK. After the model results appear showing the AR(1) coefficient and related statistics, save the output to /home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/arma_results.txt using File > Save to file in the results window.

metadata.data_source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED database, via Hill et al. POE5
